description: Given a city and a few favourites for each of two people (artists, films, shows, books, brands), returns up to six places both would enjoy, ranked by Qloo's taste graph, each with the reason and in evening order (something to do, food, a drink). Picks marked basis=combined come from Qloo's list for the combined taste because the two personal top-20 lists did not overlap enough.
name: plan_shared_evening
title: Plan a shared evening (Qloo taste overlap)
